rationale: The agent verified the user by email, fetched the correct account and order details, and confirmed the scope of the return. It stated the intended changes (return all items; refunds to original payment methods) and obtained explicit confirmation before performing writes. The returns were executed correctly via tools for all items in both delivered orders, with refunds to the original payment methods as shown in the tool outputs. Final information matched the tool results. No unsupported claims materially affected the outcome, and no policy violations (no unconfirmed writes, no wrong account/actions) occurred.
